why_ai: Marketplace mechanics are software, but telling real findings from plausible ones still needs qualified security judgment.
why_clarity: Valid findings can be reproduced, yet whether programme spend bought security is never measured.
why_digital: Submissions, triage, payouts and disclosure all happen online with researchers worldwide.

why_ai: Multi-party negotiation over timing and legal exposure with reluctant vendors does not automate.
why_clarity: Timeline norms exist, but each multi-vendor case is negotiated differently with no quick verdict.
why_digital: Coordination runs by email and trackers, though legal and national bodies add jurisdictional friction.

why_ai: Cross-border payouts, tax forms and sanctions screening are repeatable process already largely automated.
why_clarity: Each payout, screening and accrual has an exact, checkable correct result every cycle.
why_digital: Payments, tax documents and budgets are handled entirely in platform software.

why_ai: Counterfactual security measurement is ambiguous analysis, but the data exists for software to run it.
why_clarity: Security bought is undefined; whether a bug would surface anyway is known late, if ever.
why_digital: Built from submission, scanner and release data, reported to remote budget holders.

why_ai: Turning prose policy into a machine-checkable specification is exactly what software and LLMs do.
why_clarity: In-bounds status becomes a machine check made before work starts, with instant pass or fail.
why_digital: Policies, asset lists and scope checks are documents and code.

why_ai: Severity is a contested payer-versus-researcher judgment, but scope checks and comparisons automate well.
why_clarity: Scales like CVSS exist, yet scope prose and severity ratings are applied by judgment after work.
why_digital: Reports, policies and ratings are exchanged on the platform with remote researchers.

why_ai: Referencing a finding against the market's rating corpus is retrieval and comparison that software does.
why_clarity: Comparable findings recur, but worth is only meaningful in retrospect against the whole corpus.
why_digital: Calibration runs over a digital corpus of rated submissions.

why_ai: Duplicate, scanner-output and out-of-scope filtering is matching and classification needing no security expertise.
why_clarity: Each submission either matches a prior one or scope list or it does not.
why_digital: Text submissions matched against a digital archive of prior reports.

why_ai: Novel adversarial vulnerability hunting, but AI hunting agents already compete for the same bounties.
why_clarity: A reproducible valid bug is checkable, but each hunt is one-off and done by feel.
why_digital: Researchers test live targets remotely and submit reports online from anywhere.

why_ai: Closing a real vulnerability as a non-issue is a costly call that assistance supports but does not replace.
why_clarity: The queue is repetitive, but a wrong rejection produces no feedback until a breach.
why_digital: Analysts read and reproduce submissions on screen in a platform queue.

why_ai: Filtering and routing automate; validating plausible-looking findings still needs qualified analysts.
why_clarity: High-volume queue with reproducible validity checks, though plausible fakes take judgment to reject.
why_digital: Submissions arrive, are triaged and resolved entirely inside platform workflow.
